audits.purpose: Full current-table residual closure reduces repeated low-value scans after the Part105 Allerton extension.
audits.target_year_policy: Dual-year single-value rows are never reassigned to 2024 without unambiguous column evidence; existing fail-closed decisions remain authoritative unless a clearer table explicitly changes the evidence condition.
audits.apr_policy: Annual Performance Report N2O values are not substituted for absent Pollution Inventory substance rows.
audits.duplicate_policy: No new candidate created; prior report blob reconciliation confirms the explicit core-gas rows listed here were already retained in Part84 or Part85.
audits.direct_raw_policy: Official 2024 PI resource route remains known but raw facility rows are not directly consumed in this runtime; confidence policy remains capped at 98 for candidate-only numeric evidence.
audits.zero_policy: Blank, later-year, particulate, trace-metal and zero-looking values remain fail-closed and are never converted to zero.
